Blocks.Text: Section 10 of the Firearms, Control Act, 2000 (Act No.60 of 2000)
It is hereby certified that the above person has successfully completed the prescribed test on the know ledge of the Firearms
Act, 2000 (Act No 60 of 2000), and that he/she successfully completed the prescribed training and practical tests regarding
and efficient handling of a firearm,
The Firearms Control Amendment Act, no 28 of 2006 stipulates that the Competency Certificate remains valid for the same
validity as the period determined in the Act in the respect of the licence to W hich the Competency Certificate relates, unless
Competency Certificate is terminated or renew ed in accordance to the provisions of the Act.
